name: identity-defect-inventory
body:
Portable graph identity holds when every rendered identity is checkout-independent. The defect classes in the branch graph are:

1. TS synthetic root package — `ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.discoverPackages` adds the scan root as a module named `path.basename(root)` when `hasSourcesOutside(..)` sees sources outside the named packages, and `collectSources(pkg.dir)` walks recursively with zero nested-package exclusion, so one file renders as `ts.cosanima-1.0.0.testdata.src.shapes.Point` and as `ts.@apg/ts-fixture.src.shapes.Point`, and the shared cache splices worktree A's `ts.<checkout-name>.*` into worktree B. The `target/` outputs (defect 3) supply `hasSourcesOutside`.
2. Go GOCACHE self-inclusion — `go.apg/gofrontend.applyGoBuildCache` sets GOCACHE to `<git-common-dir>/apg/facts/go/<cache-key>`, and Go loads packages with Tests enabled, so Go's generated `_testmain` appears in the package file list (File `.git/apg/facts/go/<key>/53/<sha>-d`, code_type src, with zero module parent, plus `go.apg/gofrontend.test.init#<basename>` / `.main`).
3. `target/` build artifacts — the scanners ignore `.gitignore`, so each checkout's `target/**` (staged `tsfrontend/scanner.mjs`, `build/apg-*/out/tsfrontend-build/scanner.js`) lands in the graph and triggers defect 1. Main carries 9 such Files against 2 in worktrees.
4. Java default package — `src/javalib/CallGraphBuilder.java` declares zero package and `java.CallGraphBuilder.Collector.emitPkgHierarchy` returns early on an empty package: zero module record, empty File parent (orphaned), a top-level class rendering `.CallGraphBuilder`, and zero `java` Language root — the Java subtree stays invisible to module-based tools.
5. Python namespace packages — `rust.pyfrontend.Scanner.module_fqn_for` walks only `__init__.py`-bearing ancestors, so `pkg/mod.py` and `other/mod.py` both collapse to `mod`.
6. Slow `project start` — a fresh worktree at an already-scanned commit takes the delta path with an empty target set, so `rust.apg.should_spawn_language(false, true, false)` is true and every frontend spawns unfiltered (global module scaffolding is per-file). Portable identity lets start seed by copy/rebased reuse with zero frontend spawns.
